name: Industrial VFD fault and alarm codes by brand
description: What the fault and alarm codes on the display of an industrial variable-frequency drive (VFD) stand for, taken from each manufacturer's own manual. Codes are short strings that look alike across brands and mean different things: 13 is over current on a Danfoss VLT and a ground fault on an Allen-Bradley PowerFlex 40. Each record gives the code exactly as the keypad shows it, the name the manual prints beside it, and — where the manual grades events — whether it is a warning the drive keeps running through or a fault that trips it. The corrective action is not reproduced here; the linked manual page has it.
licence: factual compilation from manufacturer technical manuals
